description: This file contains unit tests for the DeviceModelCatalog component of the OpenClaw project, verifying symbol generation and presentation logic based on device attributes.

classes.name: DeviceModelCatalogTests
classes.description: A test suite for verifying the behavior of DeviceModelCatalog functions related to device symbol and presentation logic.

methods.name: `symbol prefers model identifier prefixes`
methods.description: Tests that DeviceModelCatalog.symbol returns the expected prefix-based symbol for various device identifiers.

methods.name: `symbol uses friendly name for mac variants`
methods.description: Verifies that friendly names are used to generate symbols for Mac devices.

methods.name: `symbol falls back to device family`
methods.description: Ensures that when specific identifiers are unavailable, the symbol defaults to the device family.

methods.name: `presentation uses bundled model mappings`
methods.description: Checks that the presentation function retrieves the correct title based on device family and identifier.
